# superset_dashboard_import (Resource)

Imports the dashboards of an export bundle together with the charts, datasets and databases they depend on, and imports them again whenever the bundle changes. Destroying the resource deletes the dashboards only. When one export feeds several import resources, order them with `depends_on` (datasets, then charts, then dashboards): Superset refuses to delete a dataset that charts still use.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The directory holds an export made in the Superset UI or with `superset export-dashboards`:
# dashboards/, charts/, datasets/ and databases/. The dashboards are imported again whenever
# a file changes.
resource "superset_dashboard_import" "signups" {
  source = "${path.module}/exports/signups"

  # Needed when the import creates the database; keyed by the file inside the export.
  database_passwords = {
    "databases/warehouse.yaml" = var.warehouse_password
  }
}

output "signups_dashboard_ids" {
  value = superset_dashboard_import.signups.dashboard_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source` (String) Directory in the export layout of Superset (`dashboards/`, `charts/`, `datasets/`, `databases/`), or an export zip file. A directory is bundled by the provider with a `metadata.yaml` of the right type, so one export can feed every import resource.

### Optional

- `database_passwords` (Map of String, Sensitive) Passwords of the databases of the bundle, needed when a database is created by the import. Keyed by the path of the database file inside the bundle, such as `databases/warehouse.yaml`.
- `overwrite` (Boolean) Whether objects that already exist in Superset are replaced. Without it, Superset refuses to import an object that exists. Defaults to `true`.
- `ssh_tunnel_passwords` (Map of String, Sensitive) Passwords of the SSH tunnels of the databases of the bundle. Keyed by the path of the database file inside the bundle, such as `databases/warehouse.yaml`.
- `ssh_tunnel_private_key_passwords` (Map of String, Sensitive) Passphrases of the private keys of the SSH tunnels of the databases of the bundle. Keyed by the path of the database file inside the bundle, such as `databases/warehouse.yaml`.
- `ssh_tunnel_private_keys` (Map of String, Sensitive) Private keys of the SSH tunnels of the databases of the bundle. Keyed by the path of the database file inside the bundle, such as `databases/warehouse.yaml`.

### Read-Only

- `content_hash` (String) Hash of the files of the bundle. A change of the files plans an import.
- `dashboard_ids` (Map of Number) Identifiers of the imported dashboards, keyed by the uuid of their export.
